title: Identity provider abstraction and OIDC BFF login
objective: Standards-based OIDC (authorization code + PKCE) BFF login with ZITADEL as default provider behind an IdentityProvider abstraction; login/register/logout/callback; IdP-specific admin features behind a separate trait; a mock OIDC provider for tests and offline development that production config refuses.
acceptance_criteria: Callback rejects bad state, nonce, issuer, audience, expired and forged ID tokens (tests)
No token or credential ever reaches browser storage; only an HttpOnly session cookie
Login page shows only configured methods; social login uses provider hints
Works against generic OIDC (mock IdP in tests); the same code against real ZITADEL is verified by T-0025
